CFDocument.description:
The *2024 Alabama Course of Study: Social Studies* provides the framework for Kindergarten - Grade 12 Social Studies programs in Alabama’s public schools. Content standards in this document are minimum and required (Code of Alabama, 1975, §16-35-4). They are fundamental and specific, but not exhaustive. When developing local curriculum, school systems may include additional content standards to reflect local needs and philosophies. Systems are encouraged to add implementation guidelines, resources, and activities based upon the content standards in the *2024 Alabama Course of Study: Social Studies.*

Please refer to the *2024 Alabama Course of Study: Social Studies* official source document for more information.

View **2024 ALABAMA COURSE OF STUDY: SOCIAL STUDIES
CONTENT STANDARDS CROSSWALK** by selecting the Associations button or by viewing an illustrative document following this link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IJkGI6R3Q74SHtioXkxW6lE3ha2VP3TKj-0Yf__kuKA/edit?usp=sharing

The unpacked content associated with this Course of Study was developed through an AI-assisted drafting process, reviewed and revised by Alabama subject-matter experts, and approved by ALSDE content leads to clarify the knowledge and skills embedded in the standards. This resource is intended to support instructional planning and implementation. The Alabama Course of Study remains the official source for Alabama academic standards.
